method: Logged-out Playwright (chromium, desktop UA, 6 s wait + scroll) on each public company page; parsed followers, employees ("View all N employees"), about fields and the latest posts LinkedIn shows to guests (10 per page, 20 for WAT Motor). Post date = activity id >> 22 (Unix ms). Reactions/comments from the guest feed card; the top 3 posts per company were re-checked on the public post page (schema.org interactionStatistic) and matched (max diff 2 reactions). Reposts are not shown to logged-out visitors, so reposts = null. posts_per_week = visible posts / days from oldest visible post to 2026-11-26 x 7 (guest feed may omit some posts, e.g. reposts, so this is a floor). Engagement per 1k followers = (reactions+comments)/followers*1000 per post. Topic is a keyword classification of the post text.
caveats: Sample is only the latest 10 posts (20 for WAT Motor) per page: Nov 2026 is trade-show heavy (SPS Nuremberg 24-26 Nov, ADIPEC, bauma China), which inflates trade-show share for everyone.
Follower counts 12 months ago: not obtained (web.archive.org unreachable from this environment). Snapshot URLs listed per company for manual lookup.
Type "multi-image(N)" = image post with N images; "document-carousel(Np)" = native PDF/document post with N pages.

companies.best_posts_in_common: Very active (5/week) with Koc Holding COP31 campaign content. Best: panel videos from COP31 with named speakers (224 and 197, 10 comments) and a GM visit to a university dean (200). Group campaign reposts/videos 13-30.

cross_company_patterns: Specific product + spec sheet beats generic: Yilmaz Reduktor single-image posts naming one gearbox model, its application and 4-6 technical specs get median 229.5 reactions on 21k followers (11 per 1k), 4-5x I-MAK on a similar follower base.
Photo galleries after a show beat teaser videos at I-MAK and peers: I-MAK multi-image median 82.5 vs video 34; Flender single images of ADIPEC 231-328 vs its videos 125-166.
Format alone does not decide performance: across the 10 peer pages, reactions relative to each page median are ~1.0x for image, video and document carousel alike; topic and specificity matter more.

People and named faces: SEW long-service anniversaries (404), Flender CFO with German President (215), WAT Motor panel videos with named speakers (197-224), Motovario leadership photos (90 = page best).
Light, timely hooks work for engineering brands: SEW "GTA Day / G-Day" crane image (870 reactions, page best by 2x).
Customer/application proof: SEW quarry case with a named customer (257), NORD chocolate-factory case; Sumitomo USA practical maintenance tips (70-81).
Volume without substance dilutes: Bonfiglioli posted 10 near-identical SPS/bauma videos in 3 days and averaged 0.27 engagements per 1k followers, the lowest in the set.
Holiday/national-day greetings are consistently below each page median (~0.8x), except national commemorations on Turkish pages with video.
